decision.reasoning_trace: After reviewing the product feed, many items were accessories or unrelated categories (tents, towels, stoves). Within the actual backpack options, the ZOMAKE Ultra Lightweight Hiking Backpack (prod_backpacks_173) stood out as the most reliable choice due to its 'Overall Pick' status and massive volume of positive reviews (over 14,000 ratings with a 4.6 average). The SHENHU 40L (prod_backpacks_111) was a strong contender for more intensive hiking, but the ZOMAKE offers superior versatility and proven customer satisfaction at an excellent price point.
